title: Adaptive Semi-supervised Learning for Cross-domain Sentiment Classification
answer_short: A one-layer CNN structure with max-over-time pooling, using pre-trained word embeddings and a fully connected layer with softmax activation.
answer_rationale: The architecture is described in Text 35 (page 6, section=CNN Encoder Implementation), which states that the feature encoder uses a one-layer CNN with a window size of 3, followed by max-over-time pooling to obtain the final document representation. Text 16 (page 3, section=Notations and Model Overview) confirms that the model includes a neural-based feature encoder and a fully connected layer with softmax activation for classification. The use of pre-trained word embeddings is mentioned in Text 48 (page 9, section=Training Details and Hyper-parameters).
